title: Changes to the promoters of tax avoidance scheme legislation
text:
The government will introduce legislation in Finance Bill 2026-2027 to make the promoters of tax avoidance schemes ( POTAS ) legislation more effective.

 The changes will:

 • bring VAT and indirect taxes fully within POTAS , allowing HMRC to publish details of schemes and their promoters under section 86 of the Finance Act 2022, issue stop notices more widely, and issue conduct and monitoring notices

 • allow HMRC to publish the names of promoters subject to a stop notice earlier

 The government will also make a minor correction to section 209 of the Finance Act 2026.
